title: 每天氣溫變化
question:
請輸入一週七天的最高氣溫（整數）存進清單，從第二天開始，每天輸出「今天比昨天多幾度」，一行一個（變冷就是負的，一樣就是 0），一共輸出 6 行。
提示：今天是清單裡的某一格，昨天就是它的前一格。

en.title: Temperature Change
en.question:
Input the high temperature (whole numbers) for 7 days into a list. From day 2, output how much warmer today is than yesterday, one on each line (colder is negative, the same is 0). Output 6 lines.
Tip: Today is one item in the list. Yesterday is the item before it.
